newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: ICI PAKISTAN UP 3.7 PCT ON FOREIGN BUYING.
newsitem.headline: ICI PAKISTAN UP 3.7 PCT ON FOREIGN BUYING.

text.p: ICI Pakistan Ltd, a subsidiary of ICI Plc, rose 1.10 rupees, or 3.72 percent, to 30.65 on Friday on fresh buying by foreign investors ahead of next Tuesday's board meeting, dealers said.
Some eight million 10-rupee shares changed hands in early speculative trade at the Karachi bourse, a dealer said. Speculators expect good results for the first half to June 30.
U.S.-based DuPont last month picked up a 50 percent stake in ICI Pakistan as part of a global deal to buy half of ICI Plc's bulk chemical business for $3 billion.
